headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Weathered Expanse and Dead Lands as Central Fronts Ignite
war_summary: Following earlier tumult in the island sectors, the battle lines have stabilized in Godcrofts and Linn of Mercy, shifting intense combat squarely onto the mainland frontages. In the Dead Lands, fighting flared sharply in the past two hours, marked by the Warden capture of Callahan's Gate amidst rising casualties. The snow-swept fields of Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf have become active cauldrons of combat; Weathered Expanse saw Warden forces claw back ground to establish a 4–5 split following heated exchanges at Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, while Stlican Shelf recorded multiple base flips and nearly two thousand combined casualties over the last two hours. Simultaneously, Stonecradle remains intensely divided at four Warden bases to five Colonial, driven by accelerating casualty rates and fresh contests over World's End and The Heir's Knife. Callahan's Passage continues to endure massive bloodshed with nearly three thousand casualties in two hours, while Mooring County and Marban Hollow show rapid influxes of fresh troops into contested sectors.
